## Datos

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| fig-height: 10

datos <- tribble(
  ~year, ~observations, ~species, ~users,
  2021,   1506, 564, 117,
  2022,   1168, 512, 128,
  2023,   2534, 853, 144,
  2024,   1387, 550, 160,
  2025,   1516, 649, 147
)



# Pasar a formato largo (una fila por año y variable)
datos_largo <- datos %>%
  pivot_longer(-year, names_to = "variable", values_to = "valor") %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable,
      levels = c("observations", "species", "users"),
      labels = c("Observaciones", "Especies", "Participantes")))

fondo   <- "#f4eee2"
tinta   <- "#22303C"
gris    <- "#5B6B78"
colores <- c("Observaciones" = "#2e4d83",
             "Especies"      = "#1a8a95",
             "Participantes" = "#fe8eae")

p <- ggplot(datos_largo, aes(x = year, y = valor, color = variable, fill = variable)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 21, fill = fondo, stroke = 1.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = format(valor, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")),
    vjust = -1.1, color = tinta, fontface = "bold", size = 5.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2021:2025, expand = expansion(mult = 0.06)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colores, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colores, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title    = "Gran Biobúsqueda del Sur",
    subtitle = "Uruguay · 2021–2025",
    caption  = "Datos: NaturalistaUY",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16, base_family = "lato") +
  geom_text(
  aes(label = format(valor, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")),
  vjust = -1.1, color = tinta, fontface = "bold", size = 5.5,
  family = "lato"
) +
  theme(
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = fondo, color = NA),
    panel.background  = element_rect(fill = fondo, color = NA),
    panel.grid        = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(color = tinta, size = 15),
    axis.line.x       = element_line(color = "#CFC9BB"),
    strip.text        = element_text(color = tinta, face = "bold", size = 22, hjust = 0),
    panel.spacing     = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    plot.title        = element_text(color = tinta, face = "bold", size = 32),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(color = gris, size = 18, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption      = element_text(color = gris, size = 12, hjust = 0),
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.margin       = margin(30, 35, 20, 35)
  )

p

# ggsave("fotos/biobusqueda_uruguay.png", p,
#        width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 100, bg = fondo)
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 10

fondo <- "#f4eee2"
tinta <- "#22303C"

paneles <- tribble(
  ~var,           ~nombre,         ~color,    ~relleno,
  "observations", "Observaciones", "#2e4d83", "#2e4d8399",
  "species",      "Especies",      "#1a8a95", "#1a8a9599",
  "users",        "Participantes", "#fe8eae", "#fe8eae99"
)

# Un panel interactivo por variable
hacer_panel <- function(var, nombre, color, relleno) {
  valores <- datos[[var]]

  plot_ly(
    x = datos$year, y = valores,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers+text",
    fill = "tozeroy", fillcolor = relleno,
    line   = list(color = color, width = 3),
    marker = list(color = fondo, size = 11, line = list(color = color, width = 3)),
    text = format(valores, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ","),
    textposition = "top center",
    textfont = list(color = tinta, size = 14),
    hovertemplate = paste0("<b>%{x}</b><br>", nombre, ": %{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(tickvals = datos$year, title = "", showgrid = FALSE,
                   range = c(2020.6, 2025.4), zeroline = FALSE),
      yaxis = list(title = "", showticklabels = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE,
                   range = c(0, max(valores) * 1.3), zeroline = FALSE)
    )
}

lista_paneles <- pmap(
  list(paneles$var, paneles$nombre, paneles$color, paneles$relleno),
  hacer_panel
)

# Posición vertical de los títulos de cada panel
n <- nrow(paneles)
margen <- 0.07
alto <- (1 - margen * (n - 1)) / n
techos <- 1 - (seq_len(n) - 1) * (alto + margen)

titulos <- pmap(
  list(paneles$nombre, paneles$color, techos),
  function(nombre, color, y) {
    list(
      text = paste0("<b>", nombre, "</b>"),
      x = 0, y = y, xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(color = color, size = 18)
    )
  }
)

subplot(lista_paneles, nrows = n, shareX = TRUE, margin = c(0, 0, margen, 0)) |>
  layout(
    annotations = titulos,
    paper_bgcolor = fondo,
    plot_bgcolor  = fondo,
    margin = list(t = 40, b = 40, l = 20, r = 20),
    font = list(color = tinta),
    hoverlabel = list(font = list(size = 14))
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

```
